Name: Interiors of Pelican Town - Witch's Hut
Author: QueenAcademe
Description:
[b]Description[/b]

The "Interiors of Pelican Town" suite of mods redesigns the homes and common spaces of Pelican Town. This installation redesigns the witch's hut. 

[b]Compatibility [/b]

Compatible with[b] [/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18109]Distant Lands - A Small Witch Swamp Expansion[/url] and  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url].
